name: Kuchi

shortTermThrottle.scope: Exact sliding window per client, shared by the MCP server and the /agent routes. IPv6 clients are counted per /64 network. Shared proxy IPs share the allowance.
shortTermThrottle.unit: One JSON-RPC message, or one HTTP request to /agent.

accessPolicy.websiteAndVideoPlayback: Public and outside the agent-service throttle.
accessPolicy.agentService: Open: the MCP server and the /agent manifest, catalog and workflow routes need no account or token.
accessPolicy.publicBootstrap: SKILL.md and connection links are public.
accessPolicy.analytics: Anonymous usage events (tool, outcome, duration, client, country, catalog search terms). Never the user's product details, tool results or IP addresses.

updatePolicy.refresh: The server re-reads the published catalog at most once a minute. New videos appear without reinstalling.
updatePolicy.clientBootstrap: Keep the existing MCP endpoint and installed skill.
updatePolicy.breakingChanges: Changed tool names or endpoint URLs may need a client to refresh its tool list.

description: Real product-launch videos, measured frame by frame, to use as inspiration templates. Kuchi supplies motion and taste; the user supplies their own product, assets and copy.
